k:源.mnemonic: Follow the tsunami (氵) of water back uphill to its original (原) trickle, and you are standing at the place where the whole flood began. Source (origin, original).

k:退.mnemonic: Even the most stubborn (艮) mule, seeing what waits ahead, turns round and backs off down the path (辶) it came by. Retreat (withdraw, retire, resign).

k:確.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) under a roof (宀) built of solid stone (石). No fox is getting in, and the bird struts about with complete confidence. Assurance (firm, tight, solid).
k:確.hint: Turkey safe in a stone house.

k:然.mnemonic: In the evening (夕) the dog (犬) settles by the flames (灬) and sighs. Curling up by the fire is just what you would expect of a dog. Sort of thing (so, if so, in that case).

k:刑.mnemonic: Caught stealing three (三) times, the thief faces a jailer with a knife (刂) on his belt, who counts out twenty (廾) days in the cells. Punish (penalty, sentence, punishment).

k:型.mnemonic: To punish (刑) the careless potter, the master makes him press soil (土) into the same wooden form a hundred times, every brick identical. Mould (type, model).

k:委.mnemonic: The village's grain (禾) is too precious for one person to hold, so it is entrusted to a woman (女) from each family, who sit down together and decide how to share it. Committee (entrust to, leave to, devote).

k:育.mnemonic: A cocoon (厶) tended for month (月) after month: kept warm, turned and watched, until the creature inside is big enough to fly. Bring up (grow up, raise, rear).

k:系.mnemonic: A thread (糸) with a slide (ノ) at the top: each ancestor slides down onto the thread like a bead, one generation hanging from the last. Lineage (system).

k:係.mnemonic: A leader (亻) holding the family's lineage (系) chart. Whoever keeps the list of who belongs where is the one you go and ask. Person in charge (connection, duty, task).
k:係.hint: The one holding the family chart.

k:助.mnemonic: You are already pushing the cart with all your power (力), and moreover (且) a stranger puts a shoulder to it beside you. Help (rescue, assist).
k:助.hint: A second shoulder to the cart.

k:検.mnemonic: An inspector in a hat (𠆢) makes each person (人) stand against the tree (木) and open their mouth (口) wide while he peers in. Examination (investigate).

k:刊.mnemonic: A knife (刂) carves the words into a woodblock, the inked sheets are hung up to dry (干), and the book goes out to the world. Publish (carve, engrave).

k:君.mnemonic: A neat man with a broom (ヨ) always in his right (右) hand, sweeping his doorstep. The neighbours tip their hats and address him politely. Mister (you, ruler, king).

k:念.mnemonic: What your heart (心) holds right now (今), this very moment, just before you blow out the candles. Wish (sense, idea, thought).
k:念.hint: What the heart holds this moment.

k:基.mnemonic: Before anything sweet (甘) can be picked, you must get the soil (土) right. Good earth under the fruit trees is the base everything else rests on. Fundamentals (radical, foundation).

k:移.mnemonic: Every evening (夕) the farmer drags the sacks of grain (禾) from one barn to the other, so the mice never find them. Shift (move, change, drift).
k:移.hint: Sacks moved barn to barn nightly.

k:客.mnemonic: Someone has trudged (夂) a long road and arrives under your roof (宀): an extra mouth (口) to feed tonight, and a welcome one. Guest (visitor, customer, client).

k:亜.mnemonic: One (一) broad land with the Middle (中) Kingdom at its heart, boxed in the way an old map might draw it. Asia (rank next, come after).
k:亜.hint: One land around the middle kingdom.

k:崎.mnemonic: At the far edge of Asia (亜), a big (大) mountain (山) refuses to stop at the shore and pushes its rocky nose out into the sea. Promontory (cape, spit).

k:呼.mnemonic: Through all of history (史), herdsmen have taken a pair of horns (丷) down from the hook (亅) on the wall and blown them to bring the village running. Call (call out to, invite).

k:星.mnemonic: A tiny sun, a little day (日), that comes to life (生) only after dark, one of thousands being born across the night sky. Star (spot, dot, mark).

k:省.mnemonic: Every prefecture (県) sends its paperwork down a slide (ノ) into one big office in the capital, where officials decide what to keep and what to cut. Government ministry (conserve, omit).

k:製.mnemonic: A factory system (制) turning out garment (衣) after garment, each with a little label stitched into the collar saying where it came from. Made in... (manufacture).

k:七.mnemonic: A fishhook (乙) to catch dinner and a spoon (匕) to eat it with. Do that every day of the week and count the fish. Seven.

k:応.mnemonic: A notice under the market canopy (广) asks for volunteers. Your heart (心) leaps, and you step under it and say yes. Apply (answer, yes, reply).

k:令.mnemonic: The paper carries the commander's stamp (卩) and a single word: now (今). There is no discussion, you move. Orders (laws, command, decree).

k:族.mnemonic: Every arrow (矢) flies in the same direction (方), because everyone drawing a bow belongs to the same people and faces the same enemy. Tribe (family).

k:領.mnemonic: A page (頁) of orders (令) nailed to the boundary post: inside this line, this lord's written word is the law. Jurisdiction (dominion, territory, fief).
k:領.hint: Decree nailed to the boundary post.

k:昨.mnemonic: The road takes a bend (曲) and the day just gone slides (ノ) out of sight behind it. Look back and you can no longer see it. Yesterday (previous).
k:昨.hint: The day gone round the corner.
